title: Decoding the Circuit Satisfiability Language
statement: A bit string belongs to the language of encodings of fan-in-two satisfiable Boolean DAG circuits if and only if it decodes to a circuit and the resulting variable-count and circuit pair belongs to the set of fan-in-two satisfiable DAG circuits.
